description: This Java class 'Scale' defines a data structure for managing scaling factors and offsets used for sensor data interpretation, including properties like name, unit, expression, min/max values, and format. It also includes methods for setting/getting properties, a custom toString, and an equality checker.

classes.name: Scale
classes.description: A model class representing scaling parameters and metadata for converting raw sensor values to real-world values.

methods.description: Returns a string representation of the Scale object with key properties.

methods.description: Returns the unit string associated with the scale.
